title: Review const-cast assumptions
why: const_cast changes cv-qualification, but undefined behavior depends on the original object's qualifiers and how the result is used. Legitimate API adaptation is possible; this is a contextual review rather than proof of an invalid write.
suggestion: Check the original object's const and volatile qualification and any reads or writes through the result. Preserve legitimate adaptation of mutable storage; prefer a const-correct API when available and never modify an originally const object.
limitations: Matches const_cast syntax outside comments and quoted or raw string literals, including a line break before the opening angle bracket; does not resolve original object qualification, aliases, macro expansion, or later accesses.
Does not distinguish qualification additions, legacy API adaptation, or known mutable storage from unsafe removal of const or volatile; all remain contextual review evidence.

One advisory per rule and file, located at the first matching cast line; related_files preserves every other distinct matching source line. The count describes evidence lines, not defects or individual casts.
